evidence.claim: Rule R1: Verify before you block on a weak signal: Rule R1: Verify before you block on a weak signal. If the case rests on a single signal (including a risk score alone) and your assessed fraud probability is below 0.70, recommend `VERIFY_WITH_CUSTOMER` or `STEP_UP_AUTH` before any block. Blocking a legitimate customer on one signal is a policy breach.

case.summary: Transaction 3567717 ($99.93) on card C05674-K1 was flagged by the second-generation fraud model scoring 0.992 despite a low legacy risk score of 0.13. Graph analysis revealed the transaction matched the holder's historical online channel and product type, utilized a generic iOS device with no confirmed fraud history, and lacked ring association or testing patterns. Given residual uncertainty from the calibrated model prior, customer validation was initiated. Upon the cardholder's assumed denial of the charge, card C05674-K1 was queued for blocking under policy rule R2.
